title: Tea Party
statementMd:
Polycarp invited all his friends to the tea party to celebrate the holiday. He has $*n*$ cups, one for each of his $*n*$ friends, with volumes $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$. His teapot stores $*w*$ milliliters of tea ($*w* ≤ *a*_{1} + *a*_{2} + ... + *a*_{*n*}$). Polycarp wants to pour tea in cups in such a way that:

- Every cup will contain tea for at least half of its volume
- Every cup will contain integer number of milliliters of tea
- All the tea from the teapot will be poured into cups
- All friends will be *satisfied*.

Friend with cup $*i*$ won't be *satisfied*, if there exists such cup $*j*$ that cup $*i*$ contains less tea than cup $*j*$ but $*a*_{*i*} > *a*_{*j*}$.

For each cup output how many milliliters of tea should be poured in it. If it's impossible to pour all the tea and satisfy all conditions then output `-1`.

## Input

The first line contains two integer numbers $*n*$ and $*w*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$, ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e5d84551489cb4fc0bb3ccad99a9b61ed555797d.png)).

The second line contains $*n*$ numbers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 100$).

## Output

Output how many milliliters of tea every cup should contain. If there are multiple answers, print any of them.

If it's impossible to pour all the tea and satisfy all conditions then output `-1`.

## Note

In the third example you should pour to the first cup at least 5 milliliters, to the second one at least 4, to the third one at least 5. It sums up to 14, which is greater than 10 milliliters available.
statementZhMd:
Polycarp 邀请了所有朋友参加茶会，共同庆祝节日。他有 $*n*$ 个杯子，每个杯子对应一位朋友，容量分别为 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$。他的茶壶中有 $*w*$ 毫升茶（$*w* ≤ *a*_{1} + *a*_{2} + ... + *a*_{*n*}$）。Polycarp 希望以如下方式将茶倒入杯子中：

- 每个杯子中至少装有其容量的一半茶水；
- 每个杯子中装有整数毫升的茶水；
- 茶壶中的所有茶水都被倒入杯子；
- 所有朋友都感到*满意*。

如果存在某个杯子 $*j*$，使得杯子 $*i*$ 中的茶水少于杯子 $*j*$，但 $*a*_{*i*} > *a*_{*j*}$，那么拿着杯子 $*i*$ 的朋友将不会感到*满意*。

请输出每个杯子中应倒入多少毫升茶水。如果无法倒完所有茶水并满足所有条件，请输出 `-1`。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*w*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$，![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e5d84551489cb4fc0bb3ccad99a9b61ed555797d.png)）。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 100$）。

## 输出格式

输出每个杯子中应装有多少毫升茶水。如果有多种答案，输出任意一种即可。

如果无法倒完所有茶水并满足所有条件，请输出 `-1`。

## 说明

在第三个样例中，第一个杯子至少应倒入 5 毫升，第二个杯子至少应倒入 4 毫升，第三个杯子至少应倒入 5 毫升。总量为 14 毫升，大于可用的 10 毫升茶水。
